recentRequestsDnrHint: Network-layer redirects are not logged — see the “This tab” count or the URL match tester
actionOpenConfigDesc: Open the rule list to add, edit or remove
actionCreateRuleFromTabDesc: Pick one of the APIs this page calls
actionCreateRuleFromTabSuspect: $1 origin(s) here look blocked by CORS
actionImportExportDesc: Back up or restore rule config
autoOffPickStartsOnEnable: Starts counting when the proxy turns on
createRuleFromTabFailed: Cannot create a rule for this page
apiPickerTitle: Pick an API this page calls to create a rule:
apiPickerSuspectHint: Page-reported: $1 request(s) to this origin failed in a CORS-shaped way. Being blocked by CORS, being offline, a DNS failure and a refused connection all look the same to the extension
apiPickerSuspectNote: Rows tagged 'suspect' come from requests the page itself reported as failed — CORS blocking, offline and DNS failure share one shape, so this is a lead, not a verdict
apiPickerBoundary: Lists only origins this page already requested, read from its own timing records — not listed is not proof it made no such call
profilePickerTitle: Saved environments — pick one to switch:
profilePickerConfirm: Switching to "$1" ($2 rules) replaces the whole rule set and turns the proxy switch on. Your current config is saved first as a restore point.
pageHitBoundary: This card only checks the page address itself. For API requests, see the “This tab · 5 min” cell (network-layer hits) and the request log (extension channel).
pageHitNotProxiable: This page cannot be proxied (not http/https)
pageHitProxyOff: Proxy is off, rule not active
pageHitSiteBlocked: Proxying is disabled for this site, so this rewrite won't happen
pageHitNoMatch: This page's address isn't proxied (rules usually match API hosts, not the page URL)
pageHitOpenUrlTest: Check with the URL match tester
interceptorNoData: This tab has not reported any intercepted request yet
interceptorNoReport: This page sent $1 proxy request(s) to the extension, but no accepted report from it yet
interceptorFellBack: Intercepted $1 request(s), $2 of them fell back to native (not proxied)
interceptorTimedOut: Intercepted $1 request(s), $2 of them got no response after being proxied
interceptorActive: Intercepted $1 request(s), $2 handed to the extension
interceptorDetail: Reported at $1: intercepted $2 · handed over $3 · fell back $4 · timed out $5 (one request can count in more than one — don't add them up)
configNotSynced: This page has not received the latest rules — reloading it usually fixes it
configNotSyncedHint: The rules changed after this page loaded, and that push never arrived: the page may predate an install, update or reload of the extension, or the extension is disabled for this site. Reloading the page usually fixes it; if the site is blocked, re-enable the extension for it from Chrome's extension menu.
configNotSyncedReloadFailed: Could not reload this page — please reload it manually
siteScopeBoundary: Matched by host: subdomains are included, and scheme or port does not make a second site.
siteScopeUnreadable: Couldn't read the site switch this time — leaving it as is.
siteScopeDisabledHere: Proxy disabled for this site (subdomains included)
siteScopeParentCovered: A parent domain in the list also covers this host, so it cannot be switched separately. Adjust the parent domain in Settings.
siteScopeCapReached: The site list is full at $1 entries, so this host can't be added. Remove one in Settings and try again.
siteScopeSaveFailed: Could not save the site setting — try again
